mapper.select: SELECT ad.admin_dong_id, ad.dong_population, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.category = 'CCTV' THEN 1 END) AS cctv_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.category = 'STREET_LIGHT' THEN 1 END) AS street_light_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.category = 'POLICE' THEN 1 END) AS police_office_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.category = 'SAFETY_BELL' THEN 1 END) AS safety_bell_count, latest_crime.crime_rate AS crimeRatePer10k FROM admin_dongs ad LEFT JOIN places p ON p.admin_dong_id = ad.admin_dong_id AND p.category IN ('CCTV', 'STREET_LIGHT', 'POLICE', 'SAFETY_BELL') LEFT JOIN ( SELECT gcs.gu_code, gcs.crime_rate FROM gu_crime_stats gcs JOIN ( SELECT gu_code, MAX(gu_crime_id) AS latest_gu_crime_id FROM gu_crime_stats GROUP BY gu_code ) latest ON latest.gu_code = gcs.gu_code AND latest.latest_gu_crime_id = gcs.gu_crime_id ) latest_crime ON latest_crime.gu_code = ad.gu_code GROUP BY ad.admin_dong_id, ad.dong_population, latest_crime.crime_rate
